enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Place hand under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Bend legs. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow position.
Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Take out pan. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing household chores such as vacuuming and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug power cord into outlet. Press power button. Push vacuum forward. Pull vacuum backward. Vacuum under coffee table. Vacuum near sofa. Press power button to turn off. Unplug power cord. Carry vacuum to closet. Open closet door. Place vacuum inside. Close closet door. Pick up scattered magazines. Place magazines on shelf.

Put on shoes. Pick up keys and wallet. Leave house. Walk to car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Drive to grocery store. Park car. Get out of car. Pick up shopping cart. Select items. Place items in cart. Go to checkout. Pay cashier. Place items in bags. Push cart to car. Load bags into trunk. Drive home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese. Take out cutting board. Place cutting board on counter. Cut lettuce. Cut tomatoes. Cut cheese. Place ingredients on bread. Place sandwich on plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Select channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Type on keyboard. Browse internet. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through apps. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel.

enriched_activities.activity: Outdoor exercise such as walking or jogging
enriched_activities.desc: Put on athletic shoes. Open door. Walk outside. Lock door. Start walking. Increase pace to jog. Run. Continue running. Stop at park. Stretch arms. Stretch legs. Walk back. Open door. Enter house. Lock door.

Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time reading or watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on armchair. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Put down book. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out chicken and vegetables. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Cook chicken. Stir vegetables. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Type responses. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Play game. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Nighttime routine and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch arms. Turn to back. Place hand under pillow. Turn to left side.
